What is TEDx?

TED is a nonprofit devoted to spreading ideas, usually in the form of short, powerful talks. TEDx is a grassroots initiative, created in the spirit of TED's overall mission to research and discover "ideas worth spreading." TEDx brings the spirit of TED to local communities around the globe through TEDx events.
